blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution on Thursday wrapped up its presentation of evidence against Sen. Rodante Marcoleta during the first day of the plunder case trial before the Sandiganbayan Third Division over a P75 million campaign donation. Marcoleta’s co-accused include former Rep. Mike Defensor, and businessmen Joseph Espiritu and Aristotle Viray. The prosecution rested its case after both parties agreed to dispense with the testimony of the prosecution’s last two witnesses during the trial presided by Associate Justice Fritz Bryn Anthony Delos Santos.
